title: Record a proof run
description: Builds the proof run from the suites' output at the commit CI ran, fills in a failed outcome for every automated test record that did not run, refuses an outcome for an unknown ID, and hands the statement to the provider to attest.

title: Gate a change
description: Measures the coverage at the change's commit and at the base branch's head, verifies the proof run at the change's commit, and refuses the change when an obligation present at the base lost its designed, built or proved standing or a test did not pass.

title: Gate a release
description: Measures the coverage at the release commit, verifies the proof run there, refuses the release unless every share is 100% and every test passed, and hands a passed decision to the provider to attest.

title: Resolve modules
description: Runs Go's module tools on the captured source and writes go.mod and go.sum through the apply journal. It refuses while generated code is out of date.

title: Download the module cache
description: Downloads the module zips one source revision needs into a new cache folder, checks each against go.sum, and writes the cache record.

title: Build the application
description: Builds the executable twice, offline, from the source revision, the archetype's Go SDK and the module cache, compares the two, and writes the build record and both SBOMs.

title: Build the image
description: Builds an OCI image on scratch from a trusted build record, its executable and an explicit CA bundle, and writes the image record.

title: Sign the image
description: Signs the image and attaches both SBOMs as attestations, as the provider's trusted signer: keyless cosign under the pinned reusable workflow's identity on GitHub Actions; on Konflux, Tekton Chains signs and STEGO checks the result.

title: Publish the image
description: Pushes a verified, signed image to an explicit registry repository over TLS with an explicit CA and credentials, and checks that the registry holds the exact image.

title: Scaffold a declaration
description: Writes a new declaration for a named archetype, with the smallest example content that checking accepts, and a folder for fills. It refuses to run where a declaration already exists.

title: Supersede a component digest
description: Records the successor of a component digest or of a runtime library version, the date after which it fails, and whether taking the successor needs a declaration or fill change.

title: Withdraw a component digest
description: Records that a component digest must not be used any more, with the future date after which it fails. It refuses a date that is already past.

title: Qualify a compiler release
description: Finds the checks run and the signed artifact run at exactly one commit, requires a success conclusion for every required job and every signed artifact, and writes the qualification record.

title: Verify a published compiler release
description: Installs the published release through the consumer path, checks that its tag points at the qualified commit, and cross-checks every asset digest and the release notes against the qualification.

title: Install a compiler
description: Downloads the release of one full commit, checks the size and digest of every asset and both signatures, and only then puts the binary and its build record in a new result folder.

title: Write the platform requirements
description: Writes platform-requirements.yaml during a run, from the declaration and its components' needs.

title: Write the delivery pipeline
description: Writes the service's CI file during a run, for the provider its delivery stanza names, with the pins from the registry.

title: Write the Kubernetes base
description: Writes the kustomize base and the offline Containerfile during a run.

title: Write the delivery object
description: Writes the Argo CD Application during a run, from the delivery stanza.

title: Check a delivery candidate
description: Runs every STEGO check on an image a CI provider built, and refuses to release it when any check fails.

title: Scaffold a fill
description: Writes a new fill for one slot and collection: fill.yaml, code that compiles against the slot's contract, and a test file that runs. It refuses a fill that exists, an unknown slot, and a name that is not a safe Go package name.

title: Record test evidence
description: Runs each fill's tests and, for each fill whose tests pass, writes its evidence into its fill.yaml. It records nothing for a fill with no test file, a forbidden import or a failing test, and names why.

title: Sign off a fill
description: Signs the fill's current evidence with the person's SSH or GPG key and writes the sign-off into fill.yaml. It refuses a fill with no evidence or with stale evidence. STEGO holds no key and never signs with one of its own.

title: Apply a plan
description: Writes the files of a saved plan, or of a plan it makes in the same run when it is given none, together with the new record, as one journaled transaction, and saves the record last. It refuses a plan whose inputs, record, registry content or compiler changed after planning, a hand-edited generated file unless the author allows its replacement, and a pin that is withdrawn or past its fail date unless the author overrides that pin by name, in which case the record names the override.

title: Recover an interrupted apply
description: Completes the journal that an interrupted apply left, so the generated files and the record agree again. It refuses a file that matches neither its state before nor its state after the write.

title: Make a plan
description: Runs each component's generator and the assembler on the captured inputs, and saves the plan under .stego/ with the digests it was made from. It writes no generated file and does not change the record.

title: Capture a browser asset bundle
description: Packs a frontend build folder into a deterministic ZIP with sorted entries and fixed metadata, after it checks every entry, for generation to read as a captured input. It never fetches files or scans the folder during generation.

title: Write the architecture view
description: Derives the architecture model from the run's inputs and writes the view and the model file with the generated code, inside apply, so the record covers them. It runs in every apply.

title: Fix a declaration
description: Rewrites the service's declaration, the build's input, from its declaration version to the next version the registry accepts, where the rewrite is mechanical, and names each construct it cannot rewrite with its path. It writes nothing when any rewrite fails, and it changes no generated file and no record.

title: Add a component
description: Accepts a component into the registry after its config schema, ports, slots, namespace, architecture role and outputs are checked, before its generator runs for any service. It refuses a namespace another component claims, a component that states no architecture role, and a component that emits a static file.

title: Release a component version
description: Records a new version of a component whose emitted code changed. It refuses a change to the emitted code that keeps the old version, and a slot contract change under the same slot name that fails Buf's FILE breaking rules against the contract last released.

title: Compose the active registry
description: Pins the common registry and each local registry at one reference, and composes them into one active set. It refuses a local part that would replace a common part.

title: Introduce an experimental component
description: Adds a component at stage alpha or beta, with the date it stops working, the outcome it serves, its best-in-field references or why none exists, and its promise list as output contracts. It refuses a date that is already past, and a component with no outcome, no reference statement or no contract.

title: Graduate a component
description: Moves a component one stage up the maturity ladder. At ga it removes the sunset date, and the component may take over the port name it waited for. It refuses ga for a component that does not hold a security review, a benchmark and a design review at its current digest, or whose contract set has no current reference comparison, or whose comparison leaves a reference promise undecided, or that provides a port whose conformance tests it has not passed at its current digest; it names each missing piece.

title: Withdraw a component
description: Removes a component that did not graduate, or that reached its sunset, from the active registry.

title: Curate an archetype
description: Sets the components an archetype includes, the component that answers each port by default, and the smallest example content for a fresh declaration. It refuses a component that is not ga, and a required port with no provider or with more than one.

title: Extend an archetype with a mixin
description: Adds a mixin that brings further components and slots to an archetype. It refuses a mixin that replaces a part of the archetype, or that brings a component that is not ga.

title: Define a port
description: Names a port, states what a provider undertakes to supply, states the meaning of every field each provider fills, and names the conformance test suite every provider runs. It refuses a port name that is already defined, because a changed meaning is a new port name, and it refuses a field that has no meaning.

title: Declare a slot
description: Declares a typed extension point on a component, with the protobuf contract a fill implements. It refuses a slot whose contract file is missing, a slot that no generator of the component invokes, and a contract change under the same slot name that fails Buf's FILE breaking rules.

title: Record quality evidence
description: Records a security review, a benchmark or a design review of a component at its exact digest, or a reference comparison of its contract set at that set's exact digest. It refuses evidence for a digest that is not the component's current one.

title: Promote a component upstream
description: Copies a component from a local registry into the common registry at its exact digest, at stage alpha, as a change the platform team reviews. It refuses a component whose name the common registry already holds.
